text: Which knit breaks the triality among the three triplet copies into three distinct values?
description:
OP-14: three generations with distinct masses.

Known: under the triality weave the three copies are exactly degenerate and exactly conserved. The committed knit splits all three (reach 6.74, 2.74, 1.38). A condensate on one copy gives 1 + 2 (E-FRC-0140, E-FRC-0141).

Unknown: a knit that breaks the triality into a hierarchy of three, and its relation to the warp localization of E-FRC-0030 and E-FRC-0033.

Why it matters: the count of three is algebra until a dynamics sets the three apart.

Scope: a computational investigation.

Skills: representation theory, cellular automata.

Where to start: test/experiment/gauge/generation-splitting.ts.

Evidence named: E-FRC-0140, E-FRC-0141.
